scope: Retrospective descriptive audit of saved validation metrics only; not new experiment, preregistered scientific confirmation or blind evaluation
statistics: full paired wins/losses/ties under original epsilon
saved mean checked against math.fsum full-precision deltas/n
min/max all tied query SHA identities
if original mean nonzero under epsilon: LOO near-zero and opposite-sign counts, else null/not applicable
guard_scope: During analysis block final/Host/private paths and non-primary artifacts, rank/score/index/fit/model/dispatch/writes/recovery. Native checked reader verifies public dev+validation, output selects validation only. Whole-case hashes outside guards include private-marked bytes without semantic reading.
limitations: Historical outcomes already exposed; plan is frozen before this supplemental calculation but is not prospective research registration
Query independence, representative sampling and target population not established; no p values, confidence intervals or significance claim
Leave-one-out is a single-query influence description, not multiple-query robustness
Same public dataset, different corpus/cohort/split selection; no controlled cross-cohort or cross-dataset causal comparison
epsilon only descriptive count convention; original strict mathematical preregistration/freeze untouched
failure_policy: Any missing/duplicate pair, changed input/source/identity, nonnumeric or nonfinite metric, summary disagreement, bound overrun or guard hit fails without partial success, no new project or retries that reset research; preserve failed output/log
